claim: The Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation will collapse before 2100.
claim_clarity_assessment: Unqualified future certainty and deadline contrast with conditional research estimates.
claim_evidence_interpretation: One study projects conditional collapse; another modelling announcement describes collapse as unlikely. These are not observations of a future event.
date_assessment: candidate-p2-env-003-e01: Published 2023-07-25; conditional future estimate, not observed collapse. Article text readable despite cookie-error query on redirect. candidate-p2-env-003-e02: Displayed 16:00 UTC, 2025-02-26; next 75 years is a projection interval, not an event date.
provenance_assessment: Different research teams and methods are identified; full data/citation dependence was not audited. Met Office announcement is dependent on its own paper.
research_concerns: Define the intended prediction/as-of scope and compare assumptions before presenting this as a genuine evidence-conflict case.
recommendation_reason: Define the intended prediction/as-of scope and compare assumptions before presenting this as a genuine evidence-conflict case.
